name: Banda Sinfónica Portuguesa: ALMA CATALÃ
description: A vibrant Sunday matinee performance celebrating Catalan soul, conducted by Salvador Brotons.
longDescription:
The Banda Sinfónica Portuguesa presents "ALMA CATALÃ," a concert featuring symphonic band music. This performance highlights works by Catalan composers, led by conductor Salvador Brotons. The Banda Sinfónica Portuguesa is a professional ensemble dedicated to the symphonic band repertoire, performing regularly across Portugal.

Attendees will experience a Sunday matinee concert at Casa da Música, a venue known for its modern architecture and acoustics. The performance is scheduled for midday. The program focuses on the musical heritage of Catalonia, interpreted by a full symphonic band.

This is a ticketed event. Casa da Música is located near the Casa da Música metro station, accessible via lines A, B, C, E, and F. The venue is generally accessible.
